01THE IDEA

Economics is
something you do.

Econspire is a student-led community that turns economic and business questions into live team challenges. Participants research, make a decision and explain why it could work.

01 / REAL BRIEFProblems connected to the world outside the classroom.
02 / DIFFERENT MINDSTeams compare ideas, evidence and trade-offs.
03 / LIVE DEFENCEJudges challenge the reasoning behind each proposal.
THE QUESTION IS NEVER“What is the right answer?”

It is: “Can you make a case for your answer?”

06GOOD TO KNOW

Before you
jump in.

The specifics change from one round to another. These answers explain what to check before joining.

01Can I come without a team?+

Some recent rounds let individuals register and assigned them to teams. Check the rules in the announcement for the event you want to join.

02Where do I register?+

Use the registration link in the official event announcement. Each city and round may have its own link and deadline.

03Does participation cost anything?+

It depends on the event. Past rounds have used different arrangements, so check the current announcement before signing up.

04What should I prepare?+

Read the case brief and event instructions carefully. Recent rounds asked teams to support their presentation with sources and bring a laptop.
